_note: ILLUSTRATIVE placeholder answers for the RC-1 Grid-to-Chip demo bid (OPP-0003), bid desk (BID): written for the PoC from the bid manager's point of view, not real Flex positions. No certification, turnover figure, reference or date in them is verified. Only the 16 open bid desk items are answered here; the 18 capability gaps were recorded (non-compliant, with a reason, validated) in part A and cannot be answered again. The bid desk enters no feasibility estimate: the bid manager accepts the units' estimates.

answers.response: Illustrative placeholder response: The technical tender carries one standards register for the whole solution, listing the edition of every code and standard each lot is designed to, from the MV switchgear to the cold plates and the compute systems.
answers.conditions: Editions are frozen at tender submission; any later edition is applied only by agreed change.
answers.next_steps: Each unit's design engineer confirms the editions for its scope before the register is closed.

answers.response: Illustrative placeholder response: Flex submits one tender covering Lot 4 in full; Lot 3 except the campus storage; Lot 6 for the compute hardware and its integration, without the cluster software and cloud services; and Lots 1, 2 and 5 for the Flex-made equipment only: in Lot 1 the 13.8 kV switchgear and the protection and control equipment (not the substation above 100 kV, the standby generation or the civil works of the MV feeders), in Lot 2 the 15 kV-class switchgear lineups (not the 800 VDC power blocks), and in Lot 5 the CDUs, cold plates and liquid-assisted air cooling (not the heat-rejection plant). The qualification evidence is presented separately for each lot bid, as the procedure requires.
answers.next_steps: Ask the Owner, through the portal (RF-04), to confirm that part-lot offers for Lots 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 are admissible.

answers.response: Illustrative placeholder response: Flex acknowledges that the Owner's independent design consultant owns the overall campus design. Flex designs within its lots to the consultant's campus design and agrees every lot interface with the consultant through a single interface register.
answers.next_steps: Propose a design coordination meeting with the consultant within the first weeks after award.

answers.response: Illustrative placeholder response: Flex notes that the Owner holds the utility interconnection agreements and secures the campus permits. Flex supplies the equipment data, studies and drawings the Owner needs for those applications, on the Owner's programme.
answers.conditions: The data delivered for permits is limited to the equipment in the lots Flex is awarded.

answers.response: Illustrative placeholder response: Flex states the share of work it subcontracts outside the Flex group in the tender, and every external subcontractor above 15% of price, or needed to qualify, signs the confidentiality agreement and the resource undertaking.
answers.reason: Part of the work is delivered by Flex group companies (design, manufacturing, test and integration) rather than by the bidding entity itself; treating each of them as a separate subcontractor with its own undertaking adds paperwork without adding assurance.
answers.workaround: Flex group companies are covered by one parent company undertaking that commits their resources to the contract and binds them to the confidentiality agreement; external subcontractors sign individually as required.
answers.next_steps: Legal to draft the parent company undertaking and confirm the subcontracted share once the lot scope is final.

answers.response: Illustrative placeholder response: Flex confirms that no entity subject to applicable sanctions or restrictive measures takes part in its tender in any capacity. Group companies, subcontractors and key suppliers are screened against the applicable lists before they are named in the tender.
answers.conditions: Screening is repeated at contract signature and whenever a new subcontractor is added.
answers.next_steps: Trade compliance to screen the final supplier list before submission.

answers.response: Illustrative placeholder response: Flex treats all information exchanged as confidential and uses it only to prepare this tender. Access is limited to the named bid team in the participating units, and the same obligation passes to any subcontractor that sees tender information.

Illustrative placeholder response: Flex qualifies on turnover combined across the group, which the procedure allows. The profit and loss accounts for the last two closed financial years are attached, and the turnover is shown against one-third of the value of each lot bid.
answers.conditions: The comparison uses the Owner's published lot values or, where none is published, Flex's own price for the lot.
answers.next_steps: Finance to provide the accounts and confirm the comparison for each lot.

answers.response: Illustrative placeholder response: Each participating unit provides its reference list of installed data center equipment and its years designing, building and testing the offered products, and the tender includes three reference forms, at least one for work executed by the bidder itself. Lot 6 references are drawn from the cloud unit's AI cluster deliveries.
answers.reason: 800 VDC distribution in data centers is an emerging voltage class, so few installations of comparable scale at that voltage exist yet for Lot 3. A Lot 6 reference with at least 500 tightly interconnected AI GPUs in the previous four years also still has to be confirmed.
answers.conditions: Lot 3 references at the offered voltage class are offered as pilot and test installations, supported by type-test evidence and references at comparable DC power scale.
answers.next_steps: The cloud unit confirms a qualifying Lot 6 reference; ask the Owner (RF-04) whether pilot 800 VDC installations count for Lot 3.

answers.response: Illustrative placeholder response: The tender attaches the quality, environmental and occupational safety management certificates held by the Flex sites that design and build the offered equipment. Information security certification is attached where it is held, notably for the sites and services handling the compute systems.
answers.reason: Certification scope differs by site and by unit, and ISO 27001 in particular is not expected to cover every participating site; the certificates have not been checked for this bid yet.
answers.next_steps: Each unit manager sends its current certificates with their scope; the bid desk lists any site without ISO 27001 and how its security is managed.

answers.response: Illustrative placeholder response: Flex notes the four award criteria, their minimum marks and the 66-point threshold. The technical tender is structured to the four criteria, with specific evidence for technical value, cost performance, delivery quality and safety readiness, so that each criterion clears its minimum.
answers.next_steps: Hold a review against the four criteria before submission.

answers.response: Illustrative placeholder response: Flex submits a fully priced tender, answers every mandatory requirement with detail rather than repeating it, and accepts that anything offered beyond the minimum becomes binding. Flex accepts liquidated damages for delay and performance, subject to an aggregate cap on liquidated damages and delay penalties together.
answers.reason: Liquidated damages and delay penalties have no overall limit as written, which leaves an open-ended risk on a phased multi-lot delivery.
answers.workaround: An aggregate cap on liquidated damages and delay penalties together, set as a percentage of each lot's price; the percentage is stated in the financial offer and listed in the commercial exceptions schedule (CT-08).
answers.next_steps: Commercial and legal to set the cap percentage for the financial offer; check with the Owner (RF-04) that a capped acceptance is responsive.

answers.response: Illustrative placeholder response: The technical tender stays within 300 A4 pages in 10 pt text with margins of at least 15 mm, written for this campus without brochure material, generic diagrams or cross-references. All technical assumptions sit in its assumptions section and all pricing assumptions in the financial model.
answers.next_steps: The bid desk sets a page budget per lot and checks the final document against the limits.

answers.response: Illustrative placeholder response: The tender comprises the completed technical specification, the technical tender, the financial offer model, the Appendix A data summary sheet completed in total and per partition, and the security self-assessment.
answers.conditions: The data summary sheet is completed for the lots and partitions Flex bids.
answers.next_steps: The cloud unit leads the security self-assessment with input from each participating unit.

answers.response: Illustrative placeholder response: All Flex questions go in writing through the Owner's portal before the stated deadline, and the bid team works from the answers the Owner publishes to all bidders.
answers.next_steps: The bid desk collects the units' questions into one list for submission ahead of the deadline.

answers.response: Illustrative placeholder response: The Flex bid manager is the single point of contact for this tender. All participating units are briefed not to contact any other Owner staff or the Owner's consultants about the tender.

Illustrative placeholder response: Flex does not propose an in-house designer accredited by the Uptime Institute as a Tier Designer for this bid. The participating teams design to the Owner's Tier design, and their engineers support the accredited designer who leads it.
answers.reason: None of the participating units has an in-house Uptime Institute accredited Tier Designer; BQ-09 states it as a preference, not a minimum.
